data: Is the F1 score for the red line higher than that of the dark green at the 100 author in the leftmost plot?

The question asks whether the F1 score for the red line is higher than that of the dark green at the 100 author mark in the leftmost plot. 

1. The leftmost plot represents the Emails dataset.
2. The red line corresponds to CNN-word-word-char.
3. The dark green line corresponds to SCAP.
4. At the 100 author mark, the red line (CNN-word-word-char) is above the dark green line (SCAP).

Therefore, the F1 score for the red line is indeed higher than that of the dark green at the 100 author mark in the leftmost plot.
